title: echinochloa muricata subsp. microstachya
intro: Echinochloa muricata subsp. microstachya, commonly known as 'Barnyard Grass', is a type of perennial grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties and has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of E. muricata subsp. microstachya include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help to reduce fever and alleviate symptoms of respiratory infections. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant, and its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
